index_input: title + two newlines + abstract; strip outer whitespace
tokenizer: cl100k_base; not a provider token limit or billing counter
document_aggregation: keep first ranked chunk per original dataset document_id, before document cutoff
result_order: supplied chunk ranking order; preserve ties; no cross-role score comparison
qrels_scope: original document-level positive relevance; never label all chunks relevant
macro_denominator: all queries in selected split, including empty rankings
retrieval_depth_requirement: Report unique documents returned; 100 chunks do not guarantee 100 documents. Backend collector depth/adaptive expansion remains to be selected and verified before real retrieval.
backend_status: offline chunk manifest and explicit ID mapping only; no index, DDL or embeddings created
